A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ToG-2 study. The complete main text and Appendices A–E are readable and align across versions, including figures, tables, equations and prompts.

before.justification: v6 reports original ToG-2 benchmark results, ablations, runtime measurements, manual analyses and graph-completeness experiments in Section 4 and Appendix B, including results on the authors' ToG-FinQA dataset.

after.justification: v7 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix B, including ToG-FinQA evaluations. Their retention from v6 does not change their status as original results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain the same initialization, relation pruning, context retrieval, entity scoring, iterative reasoning and stopping procedures. The prompts in Appendix E are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en, FEVER, Creak, Zero-Shot RE and ToG-FinQA. The incomplete-graph scenarios in Appendix B are also retained, with no changes to dataset, domain or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Direct, CoT, CoT-SC, Vanilla RAG, ToG and CoK; Table 2 retains the same financial-QA comparators, including GraphRAG. Comparator membership in the backbone, pruning-tool and runtime analyses also matches. The added citations introduce no evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Metrics, full-Wikipedia/Wikidata retrieval, backbone models, demonstration settings and appendix sampling procedures are unchanged. Section 4.3 retains temperature 0, width and depth of 3, and K = 10.

E4.justification: The backbone, pruning-tool and width/depth ablations in Section 4.5 are unchanged. Appendix B retains the component, threshold, self-consistency, graph-completeness, runtime and error analyses; Appendix D retains the same case studies.

E5.justification: Appendix B.8 retains the same pairwise t-test procedure and Table 12 significance reporting, including the limitation concerning unavailable baseline outputs. No repeated-run, seed or uncertainty-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout. For example, Table 1 retains ToG-2's 42.9% EM on AdvHotpotQA and 93.5% accuracy on Creak, while Table 2 retains 34.0% on ToG-FinQA. Appendix results and plotted values are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(7), their mathematical definitions and scoring rules, and the LLM-call-count expressions remain unchanged. No formal assumption, theorem, proof or mathematical correction is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about tightly coupled retrieval, deep and faithful reasoning, training-free compatibility and performance. The abstract's claim of SOTA performance on six of seven datasets is unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning contextual versus triple-based reasoning, efficiency and backbone capabilities are retained. Appendix B preserves the same qualifications about incomplete knowledge, retrieval bottlenecks, Creak errors, excessive caution and exact-match evaluation.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, model descriptions, entity-linking information, ToG-FinQA construction details and Appendix E prompts are unchanged. The source-code URL is identical, with no new technical or resource-access disclosure.

R1.justification: v7 adds Kahneman (2011), two Li et al. works on KG entity typing and completion, and Qiu et al. (2024) on RAG decoding. These supplement existing background without revising the paper's positioning. CoK remains the same cited work, now labeled Li et al. (2024c).

P1.justification: v7 replaces the preprint heading with an ICLR 2025 publication notice, adds corresponding-author markers for Chengjin Xu and Jiaxin Mao, and updates citations, including replacing the introduction's unresolved '(?)'. Section order and substantive prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The conference running header and citation additions produce limited spacing, line-wrap and page-break changes, including bibliography reflow. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–19 retain their content, captions and visual designs.

improvement.justification: v7 repairs the introduction's unresolved citation with Kahneman (2011) and adds three further references for existing KG and RAG background. This modestly improves citation completeness and traceability. The methods, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
